title: Famous buildings
examples: What materials did they use to build the pyramids?
Which building is famous for its white marble?
How did they build something so tall like the Burj Khalifa?

explain.say: Today we explore some famous buildings around the world. We will learn about different styles of amazing structures.
Next we look at the Parthenon in Greece. It is a beautiful temple built for a goddess.
The Taj Mahal in India is a stunning white marble mausoleum. It was built as a tomb.
Finally, the Burj Khalifa is known for being extremely tall. It is a modern skyscraper in Dubai.
Think about a local landmark near your school. What materials did they use to build it?

items: What is the building made of?

explain.say: A common mistake is thinking all old buildings use the same stone. Different times used different materials.

faq.q: Are all pyramids made of the same stone?
faq.a: No, the materials used for pyramids varied depending on where and when they were built. Some used local limestone, while others used different types of stone for decoration.
asks: What kind of stone is used?

faq.q: Why is the Parthenon so famous?
faq.a: The Parthenon is famous because it is an excellent example of classical Greek architecture. It was built to honor the goddess Athena.
asks: What is the Parthenon known for?
Which goddess is the Parthenon for?

faq.q: Is the Taj Mahal the biggest building?
faq.a: No, the Taj Mahal is a tomb structure, not the tallest building. The Burj Khalifa holds the record for height.
asks: Is the Taj Mahal the tallest?
What is the Taj Mahal's purpose?

faq.q: What makes the Burj Khalifa so tall?
faq.a: It is designed using modern engineering techniques, incorporating steel and glass to reach great heights. Its height is a modern feat of engineering.
asks: How did they build it so high?

faq.q: Do these buildings use different engineering skills?
faq.a: Yes, they showcase different engineering skills across history. Pyramids used massive labor, while skyscrapers use advanced materials science.
asks: What skills are needed for these buildings?

facts: Pyramids were built using massive amounts of stone blocks.
The Parthenon features classical Greek columns.
The Taj Mahal is constructed from white marble.
The Burj Khalifa is a modern skyscraper known for its height.

quiz.say: Which structure is known for its massive stone blocks and ancient design?
quiz.why: The pyramids are famous for their construction using large, ancient stone blocks.

wrong.0: The Parthenon is known for its columns, not just massive stone blocks.
wrong.1: The Taj Mahal is famous for its white marble appearance.
wrong.2: The Burj Khalifa is known for being very tall and modern.

quiz.say: If a building uses columns and white marble, it might be the:
quiz.why: The Parthenon is specifically known for its Greek columns and marble.

wrong.1: Pyramids are generally built with large, solid stone blocks.
wrong.2: While white, the Taj Mahal is a mausoleum, not primarily a temple structure like the Parthenon.
wrong.3: The Burj Khalifa is a modern skyscraper, not a classical temple.

quiz.say: What characteristic defines the Burj Khalifa among these buildings?
quiz.why: The Burj Khalifa is recognized for being one of the world's tallest modern skyscrapers.

wrong.0: The Parthenon is a temple, not designed to be the world's tallest building.
wrong.1: The Taj Mahal is a tomb, and its purpose is not related to extreme height.
wrong.3: Pyramids are ancient structures and not measured by modern height records.
